name: category_summary
description: Observed minus expected detected genes per functional category of the cog, kegg and go_slim collections, with a TU block-bootstrap CI (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.7.5, §9.3; M8-03, M8-06). The table has no coordinate fields.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category ID (COG letter, KEGG map ID or GO slim term)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable category name; NA when the resource has none

fields.name: n_detected
fields.description: Detected eligible genes in the category

fields.name: expected
fields.description: Expected detected genes: the sum of p_detect over the category's eligible genes

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower TU block-bootstrap CI bound of o_minus_e; NA with ci_few_units

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper TU block-bootstrap CI bound of o_minus_e; NA with ci_few_units

fields.name: median_abundance_log2
fields.description: Median log2 abundance of the category's detected genes; NA without abundance

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Share of eligible genes with at least one category of this collection

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined row flags (ci_few_units: fewer than 10 TUs, no CI); an ADR-A extension of §9.3 (M8-06 lead decision 2)
